newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France offers new cargo capacity to Nagoya.
newsitem.headline: Air France offers new cargo capacity to Nagoya.

text.p: Air France said 12 to 14 tonnes of cargo capacity per flight will be available on its new Airbus 340 passenger service between Paris and Nagoya, Japan, which starts on July 2.

"Ex-Paris freight currently destined for Nagoya is at present forwarded from Osaka and with a direct route, we do see some scope for developing existing trade," an Air France cargo official told Reuters.
The new, twice-weekly service, operating Wednesdays and Saturdays, will be code-shared with Japan Airlines but will not entail co-operation on freight, a JAL cargo official said.
"We feel we are serving Nagoya adequately via our freighter and passenger services to Osaka and Tokyo and don't really see any point of a cargo joint venture with Air France on this route," he added.
The two carriers already jointly operate a four-times-weekly Boeing 747-200F service between Paris and Tokyo.
Air France operates an additional freighter frequency independent of this agreement.
JAL also has a block space agreement with Air France on the French carrier's weekly 747F service between Paris and Osaka. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
